question: ______ is a high level programming language for scientific and mathematical use.
solution:
The correct answer is __**FORTRAN**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FORTRAN** is used for scientific programs and solving mathematical problems.
 
• **FORTRAN** is a general-purpose, compiled imperative programming language which is especially suited for numerical computation and scientific computing.
 
• **FORTRAN** was developed by IBM Company in the year 1950 for scientific and engineering applications, and subsequently came to dominate in scientific computing.
 
• For the past 30 years **FORTRAN** has been used for projects such as the design of bridges and airplane structures, it is used for factory automation control, for storm drainage design, and analysis of scientific data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **RFID** tags allow users to automatically and uniquely identify and track inventory and assets using wireless radio frequency waves.
 
• **Event-driven programming** is a programming paradigm in which the flow of the program is determined by events such as user actions (mouse clicks, key presses), sensor outputs, or message passing from other programs or threads.
